name: Tilapia over Toasted Pasta with Rice, Tomatoes & Lemon-Parsley Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the saucepan heats up, use your hands to break the pasta into 1-inch pieces.

Once the saucepan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the pasta and cook, stirring constantly, until it turns golden, 1-2 minutes. Stir in the rice, broth, and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
473 ml chicken or vegetable broth
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 lemon
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid in the saucepan comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice and pasta are tender and the liquid is mostly absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice and pasta are cooking, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl.
Cut off skin and white pith from the lemon; slice between the membranes to release segments. Remove seeds, roughly chop the segments, and add to the bowl with the parsley.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the lemon-parsley sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the tilapia dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ kg tilapia fillet
½ tsp paprika
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tilapia and cook, flipping once, until golden brown and fish flakes easily with a fork, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, large dice tomatoes and place in a medium bowl; add salt and half the lemon-parsley sauce (reserving the rest for the fish). Stir to combine the tomato salad.
To serve, divide toasted pasta with rice, tilapia, and tomato salad between plates. Spoon reserved lemon-parsley sauce over the tilapia and enjoy!
